name: Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC
benefit: **Financial Assistance:** ₹25,00,000/- is granted to selected candidates in three installments: - ₹10,00,000/- in the first year - ₹10,00,000/- in the second year - ₹5,00,000/- in the third year **Scholarship Validity:****** Up to three years.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must have completed a postgraduate degree from a recognized Indian university with a minimum of 55% marks. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a Ph.D. program in a foreign university accredited by the respective country's authority. 1. The applicant's age must be below 35 years as of the application deadline. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should not be beneficiary of any other govt scholarship program. 1. The Ph.D. program must be in one of the following fields: - Sociology. - Public Administration. - Law. - Economics. - Political Science. - Anthropology.
